insert into chat_session
id, session_type, session_name, creator_id, avatar, member_count, last_message_id, last_message_time, status, speak_status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user,
#{id}, #{sessionType}, #{sessionName}, #{creatorId}, #{avatar}, #{memberCount}, #{lastMessageId}, #{lastMessageTime}, #{status}, #{speakStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser},

insert into chat_session_member
session_id, user_id, user_type, nickname, role, unread_count, join_time, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user,
#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{userType}, #{nickname}, #{role}, #{unreadCount}, #{joinTime}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser},

insert into chat_message
session_id, sender_id, sender_type, message_type, content, file_urls, file_names, quote_message_id, status, send_time, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user,
#{sessionId}, #{senderId}, #{senderType}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{fileUrls}, #{fileNames}, #{quoteMessageId}, #{status}, #{sendTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser},
mapper.select: select distinct cs.id from chat_session cs inner join chat_session_member csm1 on cs.id = csm1.session_id inner join chat_session_member csm2 on cs.id = csm2.session_id where cs.session_type = 1 and csm1.user_id = #{userId1} and csm2.user_id = #{userId2} and cs.is_deleted = 0 and csm1.is_deleted = 0 and csm2.is_deleted = 0

select chat_session.id, chat_session.session_type, chat_session.session_name, chat_session.avatar, chat_session.last_message_time, chat_session_member.unread_count, chat_message.content as last_message_content from chat_session join chat_session_member on chat_session_member.session_id = chat_session.id left join chat_message on chat_message.id = chat_session.last_message_id where chat_session_member.user_id = #{userId} and chat_session.is_deleted = 0 and chat_session_member.is_deleted = 0

select chat_session_member.nickname, user.avatar from chat_session_member join user on user.id = chat_session_member.user_id where session_id = #{id} and chat_session_member.user_id != #{currentId} and chat_session_member.is_deleted = 0 and user.is_deleted = 0 limit 1

select chat_message.sender_id, chat_message.message_type, chat_message.content, chat_message.quote_message_id, chat_message.send_time from chat_message where chat_message.session_id = #{sessionId} and chat_message.is_deleted = 0 order by chat_message.send_time desc
